THEUNDERSTUDY1_EPOCH.title: Dreamless
THEUNDERSTUDY1_EPOCH.description: The [red]Architect[/red] was a creature of pure order, and order cannot conceive of what cannot exist. He could not [sine]dream[/sine]. Often he struggled to sleep, restlessly staring into a dark that never resolved into anything.
THEUNDERSTUDY1_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Unlocked|Unlockable} by defeating the Act 1 boss as the Understudy.
THEUNDERSTUDY2_EPOCH.title: Writing an End
THEUNDERSTUDY2_EPOCH.description: One [sine]sleepless[/sine] night, a thought took shape. Every story requires an ending, such is the natural order of stories, including his own. He resolved to write his story in a book: with a final, restful conclusion, and the beginning of a new story in his place.
THEUNDERSTUDY2_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Unlocked|Unlockable} by defeating the Act 2 boss as the Understudy.
THEUNDERSTUDY3_EPOCH.title: A Perfect Mirror
THEUNDERSTUDY3_EPOCH.description: The [red]Architect[/red] created a child, and poured his secrets into it — order, design, the shape of every law he knew. In time the child became flawless. A perfect mirror of its maker. A perfect story.
THEUNDERSTUDY3_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Unlocked|Unlockable} by finishing a run as the Understudy.
THEUNDERSTUDY4_EPOCH.title: Consumed
THEUNDERSTUDY4_EPOCH.description: The [purple]blight[/purple] took the child in the space of a breath. Lost in his strange, [sine]dreamless slumber[/sine], the [red]Architect[/red] never noticed that his ending had been unmade.
THEUNDERSTUDY4_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Unlocked|Unlockable} by completing a run on Ascension 1 or higher as the Understudy.
THEUNDERSTUDY5_EPOCH.title: Taken
THEUNDERSTUDY5_EPOCH.description: Years after waking from his poor sleep, a [sine]distant memory fragment[/sine] surfaced: a child, an ending, the promise of true rest. He could no longer craft a perfect one. So he crept down into the city, into a small bedroom, and carried a [sine]sleeping boy[/sine] to the top of the [gold]Spire[/gold].
THEUNDERSTUDY5_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Unlocked|Unlockable} by defeating 15 Bosses as the Understudy.
THEUNDERSTUDY6_EPOCH.title: Nothing Like Him
THEUNDERSTUDY6_EPOCH.description: The boy was reckless, and loud, and endlessly irritating — nothing like the [red]Architect[/red] at all. But the gifted boy admired him with all his heart. For years the [red]Architect[/red] labored to mold that devotion into perfection, but the boy ended up wandering off into [sine]dreams and music[/sine].
THEUNDERSTUDY6_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Unlocked|Unlockable} by defeating 15 Elites as the Understudy.
THEUNDERSTUDY7_EPOCH.title: Every Story Has a Lesson
THEUNDERSTUDY7_EPOCH.description: One [sine]sleepless[/sine] night, the [red]Architect[/red] decided the time had come for the Final Lesson — which was also the Final Test. He woke the boy up, and asked of him for one thing: to put an end to his story.
THEUNDERSTUDY7_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Unlocked|Unlockable} by defeating the Act 3 boss as the Understudy.
